mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and lower household wealth, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls >10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -2% signals deteriorating manufacturing activity and lower earnings momentum, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls >2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises >2.5% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6.5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, which increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls >6.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening consumer demand and lower earnings power, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls >3% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).
